player_prompt.intro:
I ka kɛlɛ Sokoban. Aw bɛ player, aw bɛna kɛlɛ ka bɔ kɔɔrɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔ.
        Aw bɛ kɛlɛ ka bɔ kɔɔrɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔ, aw bɛ se ka bɔ kɔɔrɛ kɛlɛ bɛɛ.
        Aw tɛ se ka bɔ kɔɔrɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔ waati, aw tɛ se ka bɔ kɔɔrɛ kɛlɛ bɛɛ.
        Kɔɔrɛ kɛlɛ la, aw bɛna kɛlɛ: 
        - Aw (player) bɛna 'P' 
        - Waati bɛna '#' 
        - Bɔ kɔɔrɛ bɛna 'X' 
        - Kɔɔrɛ kɛlɛ bɛɛ bɛna 'O'
        - Bɔ kɔɔrɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔ bɛna '√'
        Aw bɛ se ka [w] kɔɔrɛ ka bɛɛ, [a] kɔɔrɛ ka kɔnɔ, [s] kɔɔrɛ ka bɛɛ, [d] kɔɔrɛ ka kɔnɔ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sɛbɛn juguya maana tɛ kanburu kɛnɛ. Sɛbɛn don [up], [down], [left], [right] alɛ [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: O ye ko juguba lo ye.
invalid_move.wall_collision: I tɛ se ka don kogo dɔ kɔnɔ!
invalid_move.invalid_position: A tɛ se ka taga o yɔrɔ la.

game_message.pushed_prefix: a ye sɛbɛri dɔ ɲɔni ka taga n'a ye.

outcome.win: A diyara n' ye k'a lɔn ko aw sera ka Sokoban dugu la!
outcome.turn_limit: I ma se ka koo kɔrɔ lɔn.
